div.div:
PtpConfigs
• test-grandmaster — worker2, ens3f0 (priority1 0, clockClass 6, masterOnly)
• test-slave1 — worker, ens1f0 (slaveOnly)
GM phc2sys disciplines the NIC PHC from the system clock; the slave phc2sys disciplines the OS clock from its PHC.
Gray ports and dashed gray links take no part in this scenario.

text.tspan: GM phc2sys disciplines the NIC PHC from the system clock;
the slave phc2sys disciplines the OS clock from its PHC.
Gray ports and dashed gray links take no part in this scenario.
